clauses.title: The transport section states the attestation shape
requires: An attestation entry names `source`, `kind`, and `readCompletely`; the identity of each required entry lives in the parent's expectation, which the child never copies (CL-D69)

clauses.title: The Every-gate block tells the child the attestation shape
requires: `evidenceRead` carries the supplied evidence records, each with `readCompletely` set true after reading and no identity (CL-D69)

clauses.title: The CL-D69 record states the shape, the unchanged assurance, and the boundary
clauses.section: ## CL-D69 — The evidence attestation carries no identity
requires: the identity of each required entry lives in the parent's expectation
Reintroducing an identity in the attestation, or matching it by anything but `source` and `kind`, requires a new owner decision

clauses.title: The CL-D69 fixture pins the schema, the validator, the composer, the prose, and the record
requires: the evidence attestation names source, kind, and readCompletely; the identity stays in the expectation (CL-D69)
